result.stdout:
dotnet polhem keys protect - Generate a key and print it encrypted with the master key

Usage: dotnet polhem keys protect [options]

Prints a Base64 value for SecurityKeySettings in SystemSettings.xml, such as
ApiEncryptionKey or ConfigEncryptionKey. Use the master key the host reads, or
the host cannot decrypt the value.

Options:
  --master-key-env <name>   Read the master key from this environment variable.
                            Default: POLHEM_MASTER_KEY.
  --master-key-file <path>  Read the master key from this file instead.
  --help, -h                Print this help text.

result.stdout:
dotnet polhem forms import - Turn a workbook into definition files

Usage: dotnet polhem forms import <file.xlsx> --define <directory> [options]

Writes the FormSchema and a TableSchema per table, generates the FormLayout when there is none,
and registers the form in DbCategorySettings, ProgramSettings, MenuSettings and the zh-TW
language files. A workbook of either language is read the same way. Nothing is written when the
workbook or the form has an error.

Options:
  --define <dir>       The definition folder to write to. Required.
  --tables <mode>      What to do with an existing TableSchema:
                         merge      add the columns and indexes the form brings (default)
                         keep       leave it as it is
                         overwrite  replace it with the one generated from the form
  --regenerate-layout  Replace an existing FormLayout. Default: keep it (it may be hand-tuned).
  --dry-run            List the files that would change without writing them.
  --help, -h           Print this help text.
